figures.finding: The Slovenian Film Centre (SFC), a public agency, co-finances Slovenian fiction features by competition: its 2026 call offered EUR 5.5 million for features and first features (and EUR 800,000 for original TV drama series), at most EUR 1,000,000 a feature, EUR 700,000 a first feature and EUR 800,000 a series, with state aid at most 50% of eligible costs (80% for low-budget, youth, children's or difficult projects); at least 80% of the SFC's money must be spent in Slovenia (60% for an international co-production).

value.name: Slovenski filmski center (SFC): Javni razpis za sofinanciranje realizacije slovenskih igranih filmskih in avdiovizualnih projektov 2026

figures.applies: Slovenia; Slovenian fiction feature and TV series production, 2026 call (Uradni list RS 106/2025 of 19 December 2025).

sources.said: 5.1. Predvidena vrednost vseh razpoložljivih sredstev, namenjenih za javni razpis znaša 5.500.000,00 EUR za področje realizacije igranih filmov in realizacije celovečernih prvencev ter 800.000,00 EUR za projekte realizacije igranih izvirnih igranih televizijskih serij. 5.2. Najvišji možni znesek sofinanciranja posameznega projekta na javnem razpisu znaša: - 1.000.000,00 EUR za realizacijo igranih filmskih projektov (iz točke 1.1.1.), - 700.000,00 EUR za realizacijo celovečernih prvencev (iz točke 1.1.2.) ter - 800.000,00 EUR za realizacijo izvirnih igranih televizijskih serij (iz točke 1.1.3.) … 5.5. Intenziteta državnih pomoči znaša največ do 50 odstotkov, razen v primeru nizko proračunskega, mladinskega ali otroškega oziroma zahtevnega projekta, ko lahko znaša največ do 80 odstotkov vseh izkazanih upravičenih stroškov celotne vrednosti filma oz. projekta. … morajo porabiti vsaj 80 odstotkov stroškov sofinanciranega zneska s strani agencije na območju Republike Slovenije, oziroma v primeru, da projekt nastaja kot mednarodna koprodukcija, vsaj 60 odstotkov stroškov sofinanciranega zneska s strani agencije na območju Republike Slovenije.

figures.finding: Of 37 eligible applications to the SFC's 2026 fiction production call, 14 were funded (published 2 September 2026): seven features at EUR 500,000 to 900,000 each, with state-aid intensities from 34.37% to 80%, and seven shorts at EUR 76,000 to 90,000. In 2025 the SFC's budget was EUR 12,713,945, of which EUR 10,944,630 went to production and development.
figures.applies: Slovenia; SFC fiction production call 2026; SFC budget 2025.

figures.finding: Slovenia's cash rebate pays up to 25% of a project's acknowledged (post)production expenses incurred in Slovenia, for features, documentaries, TV drama and animation (not commercials, reality TV, game shows or soaps); the applicant must be a Slovenian producer or service provider with a publicly shown work in the last three years, and apply at least a day before shooting; the 2025-26 call ran from 29 September 2025 to 25 September 2026, and eleven projects received EUR 534,027.50 in 2025.

value.name: Denarna povračila za vlaganja v avdiovizualno produkcijo (cash rebate)

figures.applies: Slovenia; productions serviced by a Slovenian producer or service company; call 2025-26.

sources.said: The eligible production formats include feature films, documentaries, TV drama, and animation. The incentive does not apply to commercials, reality TV, game shows, and soaps. The cash rebate amounts up to 25 % of the total acknowledged expenses for the realisation of the (post)production of an individual project, incurred in the territory of the Republic of Slovenia. … The applicant must be a Slovenian producer, co-producer, or production service provider that has produced or provided production services for at least one publicly shown audiovisual work within the last three years. The complete application must be submitted to the Slovenian Film Centre at least 1 day before the shooting commences.
Denarna povračila za vlaganja v avdiovizualno produkcijo 29.9.2025 - 25.9.2026
